items.prompt: Qual é a saudação usada pela manhã?
items.explanation: "Good morning" é usado do amanhecer até por volta do meio-dia.

items.prompt: Complete: "My name ___ Ana."
items.explanation: Com o sujeito "my name" (terceira pessoa), usa-se "is".

items.prompt: Onde Tom mora?
items.passage: Tom is from Brazil. He lives in a small house in Lisbon. He works at a bakery.
items.explanation: O texto diz "He lives in a small house in Lisbon".

items.prompt: O que a pessoa pediu?
items.audio_script: I would like a coffee and a glass of water, please.
items.explanation: A frase menciona "a coffee and a glass of water".

items.prompt: Complete: "Yesterday I ___ to the cinema."
items.explanation: "Yesterday" exige passado simples: "went".

items.prompt: Escolha a opção correta: "There ___ some milk in the fridge."
items.explanation: "Milk" é incontável, então usa-se "there is".

items.prompt: Por que a loja fechou mais cedo?
items.passage: The shop closed at 4 p.m. yesterday because the owner had a medical appointment. It will open at the usual time tomorrow.
options: O dono tinha uma consulta médica

correct_answer.value: O dono tinha uma consulta médica

items.explanation: O texto diz "because the owner had a medical appointment".

items.prompt: Que horas o trem parte?
items.audio_script: The train to Manchester leaves at half past seven from platform three.
items.explanation: "Half past seven" significa sete e meia.

items.prompt: Complete: "If I ___ more time, I would travel more often."
items.explanation: Segunda condicional: "If + passado simples, would + verbo".

items.prompt: Qual alternativa tem sentido mais próximo de "give up"?
items.explanation: "Give up" significa desistir, equivalente a "quit".

items.prompt: Qual é a principal preocupação mencionada no texto?
items.passage: Remote work has become common in many companies. While employees often report better balance between work and personal life, managers worry that informal communication between colleagues is disappearing.
options: A perda de comunicação informal entre colegas
A falta de equipamentos em casa

correct_answer.value: A perda de comunicação informal entre colegas

items.explanation: O texto diz que os gestores temem o desaparecimento da comunicação informal.

items.prompt: O que o falante recomenda?
items.audio_script: If you are visiting the museum on a weekend, I would strongly recommend booking your ticket online, because the queue can be quite long.
items.explanation: O falante recomenda "booking your ticket online".

items.prompt: Complete: "By the time we arrived, the meeting ___."
items.explanation: Ação anterior a outra no passado exige o past perfect.

items.prompt: Escolha a alternativa mais adequada: "The results were ___ inconclusive."
items.explanation: É necessário um advérbio para modificar o adjetivo "inconclusive".

items.prompt: Qual é a posição do autor?
items.passage: Although automation has undeniably displaced certain roles, framing it purely as a threat overlooks the historical pattern: each wave of technological change has ultimately created more occupations than it eliminated, albeit with painful transitions for those caught in between.
options: A automação tende a criar mais ocupações, apesar de transições difíceis
A automação destrói empregos de forma definitiva
A automação não afeta o mercado de trabalho
A automação deve ser interrompida por lei

correct_answer.value: A automação tende a criar mais ocupações, apesar de transições difíceis

items.explanation: O autor reconhece a perda de postos, mas defende que historicamente surgem mais ocupações.

items.prompt: Qual é a atitude do falante em relação à proposta?
items.audio_script: I can see the appeal of the proposal, and parts of it are genuinely well thought out, but I am not convinced that the budget assumptions hold up under scrutiny.
options: Parcialmente favorável, com reservas sobre o orçamento

correct_answer.value: Parcialmente favorável, com reservas sobre o orçamento

items.explanation: O falante reconhece méritos, mas questiona as premissas orçamentárias.

items.prompt: Qual posição a autora defende sobre digitalizar o acervo?

items.passage: Putting the library's collection online would undoubtedly help readers who cannot travel. Yet calling it a complete replacement for the building overlooks people without reliable internet access. The author proposes investing in digital access while retaining staff who can guide visitors in person. Success, she argues, should be measured by who gains access, rather than by how many services disappear from the budget.

items.prompt: Qual condição a pessoa considera necessária para aceitar a proposta?
items.explanation: A resposta deve ser sustentada pelo estímulo apresentado.
items.audio_script: The discount sounds attractive, but I would not accept the proposal as it stands. They call renewal convenient, although it leaves customers paying unless they notice a small message and cancel. I would reconsider if renewal required explicit consent and the full cost appeared before payment. Lowering the introductory price alone would not address my concern about how the agreement works.
